name: Cầu Đất
note: Red grape and brown sugar, a crisp high-altitude cup from the slopes above the workshop.

name: K'Ho Lang Biang
note: Dried longan and dark cherry, grown by K'Ho smallholders at the foot of Lang Biang.

name: Khe Sanh
note: Cane sugar sweetness with a soft citrus finish, from the basalt soil of Quảng Trị's highlands.

name: Sơn La
note: Green apple and jasmine, a bright northern-highland arabica roasted light to keep its acidity.

name: A Lưới
note: Stewed plum and cocoa, a fuller-bodied cup from the central highlands near Huế.

name: Đắk Lắk
note: Toasted hazelnut and milk chocolate, the steady, familiar robusta-growing heartland.

name: Mây House Blend
note: Our everyday cup: arabica for sweetness, a little robusta for body — built for phin and moka pot alike.

name: Mây Espresso Blend
note: Dark chocolate and caramelised sugar, roasted for a thick, sweet shot that holds up in milk.
